title: Field Notes 06: the four elements and the four seasons
caption:
In the classical texts, each element has a season.

Spring belongs to Air, summer to Fire, autumn to Earth and winter to Water. Traditionally, each temperament feels most at home in its own season, and needs a little extra care in the opposite one.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

What's your favourite season? Comment it, then tag the friend who hibernates every winter.
